hooks.command: node -e "const chunks=[]; process.stdin.on('data',c=>chunks.push(c)); process.stdin.on('end',()=>{ const d=JSON.parse(chunks.join('')); const f=(d.tool_input&&d.tool_input.file_path)||''; if(/\.(ts|tsx|py|sql|prisma)$/.test(f)){ process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PostToolUse',additionalContext:'CLAUDE.md reminder: modified '+f+' — update CLAUDE.md if this change adds/removes/modifies endpoints, models, security controls, env vars, or architecture.'}})); } });" 2>/dev/null || true
